kindHints.mcp: Paste an MCP server URL. If it needs a login, we'll take you to authorize it.
kindHints.openapi: Import an API from its OpenAPI/Swagger spec and choose which operations to use.
kindHints.sql: Read-only, parameterized SQL queries on PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQL Server.
kindHints.http: Templated HTTP calls to any REST API, no spec needed.

connections.name: Name
connections.secretHint: Stored encrypted. The model never sees it and it never appears in logs.
connections.sqlHint: Recommended: a database user with read-only permissions.
connections.deleteConfirm: Are you sure? Its tools will be removed from every agent.

whmcs.name: WHMCS
whmcs.hint: Clients, services, invoices and support tickets from your WHMCS.
whmcs.help: In WHMCS: Configuration › System Settings › API Credentials (an admin with the “API Access” permission). As our servers have no fixed IP, also add an API access key (below).
whmcs.accessKeyHint: The value of $api_access_key in your WHMCS configuration.php. Lets BrainAgent call the API without relying on the IP allowlist (our servers have no fixed IP).
whmcs.accessKeyBody: Our cloud servers have no fixed IP, so the WHMCS IP allowlist will block them sooner or later. Add the line $api_access_key = 'a-long-key'; to your WHMCS configuration.php and paste the same key here.
whmcs.accessKeyFail: Key saved, but WHMCS does not answer: {error}
whmcs.accessKeyFirewall: If it hangs and times out, your server firewall is blocking our connections: allow access to includes/api.php from any IP (the key protects the API).

microsoft365.name: Outlook 365
microsoft365.hint: Mail and calendar from an Outlook / Microsoft 365 account.
microsoft365.help: We'll take you to Microsoft to sign in and accept the permissions: read and send mail and manage the calendar.

googledrive.name: Google Drive
googledrive.hint: Create folders and documents and upload files (chat attachments, invoice PDFs) to your Google Drive.
googledrive.help: We'll take you to Google to sign in and accept the permission. OlaBrain only sees the files and folders it creates, not the rest of your Drive.

holded.name: Holded
holded.hint: Invoices, contacts, products, payments and treasury from your Holded.
holded.help: In Holded: Settings › Developers (API) › create a key. Grant read and write on sales invoices and contacts, and read on products, taxes and bank accounts.

factorial.name: Factorial
factorial.hint: Employees, time off, vacations and clock-ins from Factorial.
factorial.help: In Factorial (as an admin): Settings › API Keys › New key. The key gives company-wide access; the agent asks for confirmation before recording time off or clock-ins.

sesame.name: Sesame HR
sesame.hint: Employees, vacations, absences and clock-ins from Sesame HR.
sesame.help: In Sesame (as an admin): Settings › Integrations › API › Create token. The same screen shows your account's region (usually eu1).
sesame.regionHint: The one shown next to the token in Sesame, e.g. eu1.

studio.name: Name (snake_case)
studio.descriptionHint: Explain what it returns and when to use it. The LLM reads this to decide.
studio.pathHint: Relative to the base URL. Use '{{parameter}}'.

home.metaTitle: OlaBrain — Digital employees you run by voice

home.titleA: Create agents, connect them to anything and
home.badgeVoice: Digital employees you run by voice
home.proof: Data hosted in the EU · GDPR compliant · The agent says it is an AI
home.demoBody: Press the button and ask anything: how OlaBrain works, what it can do for your company or how it connects to your systems.
home.galleryBody: Twelve characters ready to work, each with its own voice and personality. Give them instructions, connect your tools and they start.
home.voicePrompt: Ask by voice in plain language:
home.voiceExample: “Alba, which invoices were issued today? Send me the PDF of the last one.”
home.howBody: No code. Each agent with its own permissions and a confirmation before changing any data.

create.title: Create
create.body: Pick a character, set its tone and instructions, and give it memory of each contact.

connect.title: Connect
connect.body: Connect your apps (Holded, WHMCS, Outlook, Google Drive, Factorial, Sesame), any MCP server, APIs or databases.

automate.title: Automate
automate.body: Your agent looks up, drafts and acts: invoices, emails, tickets, documents. It always confirms before changing data.

home.intTitle: Connect your models, apps and data
home.intBody: Credentials are stored encrypted and the model never sees them. Every tool that writes asks for confirmation.
home.intFoot: AES-256 encryption per organization and outbound calls filtered against SSRF.

eu.label: Data in Europe

aes.label: Credentials
